انشغفوا (form VII)
# اِنْشَغَفُوا (inšaḡafū) /in.ʃa.ɣa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
# اِنْشَغِفُوا (inšaḡifū) /in.ʃa.ɣi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
